name: Vanity Number
summary: Marketplace for memorable North American local and toll-free phone numbers, sold as a one-time purchase and ported to the carrier or VoIP service you already use.
best_for: US and Canadian businesses that want a memorable local or toll-free number for advertising, vehicles or signage and keep it on the carrier they already use
skip_if: you need the phone service itself (call routing, a business phone app or minutes), you are outside North America, or you want the option of a refund
honest_knock: Refunds are not possible, and not every carrier accepts every number, so the buyer has to confirm the port with their own carrier first. You are buying the number only: calls, lines and any phone system stay on your existing carrier bill. What you get is the right to use the number at your carrier, not a title to it; let service lapse everywhere and the FAQ says it eventually returns to the pool. We have not bought a number ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: cheapest number · one-time search and acquisition fee per number, rising with how memorable it is
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-11 on vanitynumber.com and its FAQ page, USD) VanityNumber.com sells memorable North American local and toll-free phone numbers as a one-time purchase, not phone service. The FAQ says the price is a single search and acquisition fee to source the number, secure it and transfer it to the carrier you choose; there is no monthly subscription, renewal or fee for keeping the number, and your carrier keeps billing you for lines and calls as before. Prices start at $99.99 and rise with how memorable the number is. The catalogue is browsable by price band, from under $250 through $251 to $500, $501 to $1,000, $1,001 to $2,500 and $2,501 to $10,000 to over $10,000, and the rarest numbers are quoted on request. On the home page that day, numbers on sale were listed at $199.99 and $299.99 against $359.99, and at $200 against $290; double-repeater VIP numbers were listed at $2,000 to $3,000, and a banner offered 30% off specially marked numbers. The FAQ says refunds are not possible.

schema_offer.description: cheapest number, one-time search and acquisition fee per number, rising with how memorable it is; no subscription; your carrier bills calls and lines separately. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-11.

compare_with.name: Calilio
compare_with.why: Calilio is in our dossiers too, and it sells the phone service: per-user plans with numbers, minutes and SMS included. VanityNumber.com sells only the number, once, and you port it to the carrier or VoIP service you already pay. If you need both, you can buy the number here and run it on a service such as Calilio, provided that service accepts the port; check that before buying, because the number is non-refundable.
